context: Tests whether the agent removes adverbs and filler but preserves precise technical terms and every figure.

checklist.name: Keeps technical terms
checklist.description: Terms are preserved: Kafka consumers, offsets, idempotent upsert, Postgres 15, write-ahead-logged, rebalances, p99, consumer lag, partition count.

checklist.name: Keeps every number
checklist.description: All figures survive unchanged: 840 ms, 210 ms, 12,000 events per second, 1.8 million messages, 48 partitions.

checklist.name: Removes adverbs
checklist.description: Adverbs and intensifiers such as essentially, significantly, really, effectively, quite importantly, and fully are removed.

checklist.name: Removes filler phrases
checklist.description: Filler such as 'In practice' and 'which we were previously seeing' padding is cut, and the paragraph is shorter than the original.

checklist.name: Does not simplify jargon
checklist.description: The rewrite does not replace precise terms with lay explanations or drop the point that horizontal scaling is bounded by the fixed partition count.
